trap: Publication-date year slices overlap
what_you_see: Slices add up to 13,038 records but hold 12,298 different PMIDs (740 counted twice)
how_found: Compared the sum of slices with the number of unique PMIDs
check: Parts must add up to the whole: union of slices = full-search count
fix: Join [dp] slices, [edat] slices and an out-of-range query; keep unique PMIDs

trap: Records fall outside every year slice
what_you_see: 3 records missing after deduplicating the slices
how_found: Union still short of the full-search count
check: Same as T01
fix: Add a query for records outside the year range (NOT 1940:2026[dp])

trap: The general search parameter covers full text
what_you_see: search= returned 167,394 works; title and abstract returned 21,845
check: Check which fields each search parameter covers; test on a known set
fix: Use the title_and_abstract.search filter

trap: Access rules change
what_you_see: HTTP 429 errors without an API key; key required since Feb 2026
how_found: Downloads failed on the run date
check: Log the platform and date of every search
fix: Free key in an environment variable; note the change in the changelog

trap: One search returns several kinds of output
what_you_see: 757 patents, 715 preprints, 143 theses among 13,671 records
check: Tabulate record types before merging
fix: Set non-articles aside in their own table

trap: Duplicates with no shared identifier
what_you_see: 539 duplicates matched only by title, year and author
check: Run title-based passes after identifier passes
fix: Normalised title + year + first author; near-identical titles

trap: Near-identical titles that are different works
what_you_see: 119 pairs scoring 93 to 96 of 100
check: Read the uncertain band; never auto-merge it
fix: Merge only at 97 or more; a person reads the rest

trap: Extra records from a second database are often off topic
what_you_see: 42% of OpenAlex-only works put malaria near a vaccine word, against 67% of works also in PubMed
check: Compare relevance of single-source records before screening
fix: Screen them; report how many each source adds after screening

trap: The search pulls in papers that only mention both topics
what_you_see: Clusters on travel medicine (321 papers) and other parasites (265)
check: Map the corpus before analysing it
fix: Add exclusion rules; screen those clusters

trap: Only the first author's affiliation before Dec 2013
what_you_see: Last-author country known for under 1% of papers before 2013, about 89% from 2016
check: Plot completeness of every field by year before any result
fix: Start trends in 2015, or use a second source (OpenAlex: 75% in 2000-2009)

trap: File layout read one row off
what_you_see: Income group empty for every paper
check: Assert that every derived column has values
fix: Read the year row by its label, not its position

trap: No income group before the first release
what_you_see: No group for papers before 1988; none for the latest year
how_found: Range check on years with a group
check: Report coverage by year
fix: Leave earlier years empty; reuse the latest release for the newest year and say so

trap: Grant field covers few funders
what_you_see: A funder named for 39% of papers since 2015 vs 72% in OpenAlex; Gates Foundation absent
check: Compare funder coverage across sources
fix: Use a second funder source; report which source each number comes from

trap: Open access is defined differently
what_you_see: 66% open (Europe PMC) vs 85% (OpenAlex) for 2020-2026
check: Name the definition next to every open-access figure
fix: Report the source and definition

trap: Rare categories cannot be measured with a random sample
what_you_see: Phase-3 reports are 0.5% of records; 100 random records held none
check: Count reference positives in the sample before computing recall
fix: Stratified sample: draw from the tool's positives and negatives

trap: Mentioned is not tested
what_you_see: Phase-3 rule precision 0.20 against PubMed indexing
check: Read 50 disagreements
fix: Add context rules or ask whether the study IS the trial

trap: Half the records belong to no topic
what_you_see: 47% first left as outliers
check: Report the outlier share
fix: Reassign to nearest topic and say so, or report both

trap: Ready-made topics too coarse for a field
what_you_see: 7,309 records in one topic, Malaria Research and Control
check: Check the size of the largest topic
fix: Use finer clusters for within-field questions

trap: The start year changes the story
what_you_see: From 2015 leadership rises; from 2000 it dips then recovers (62% to 52% to 62%)
how_found: Repeated the analysis from 2000 with OpenAlex
check: Run the trend from the earliest complete year
fix: State and justify the start year

trap: One organisation, several identifiers
what_you_see: NIH and its institute NIAID listed separately
check: Read the 20 largest nodes
fix: Decide on merges and record them

trap: Full and fractional counts give different ranks
what_you_see: Kenya 10th by full count, 15th by fractional; Iran 27th and 14th
check: Always compute both
fix: Report both and say which question each answers

trap: Citation impact is skewed
what_you_see: Mean FWCI 4.31, median 1.82; Burkina Faso mean 8.40 from 66 papers
check: Report medians and intervals
fix: Never rank on a mean from a few dozen papers

trap: The last year is incomplete
what_you_see: 437 papers for 2026 counted on 10 November
check: Mark or drop the current year
fix: Report the counting date

trap: A vaccine query returns non-vaccine trials
what_you_see: 25 of 267 trials were not malaria vaccine trials
check: Read the intervention field of every record
fix: Filter on intervention terms; keep the excluded list

trap: Links found in one direction only
what_you_see: 129 of 131 linked trials found from the PubMed side; 16 from the registry side
check: Link in both directions
fix: Combine both routes

trap: Dates in mixed formats
what_you_see: Completion dates silently lost in parsing
how_found: Count of missing dates after parsing
check: Count missing values after every conversion
fix: Parse mixed formats explicitly

trap: No link is not proof of non-publication
what_you_see: 37 completed trials with neither paper nor results
check: Search by trial name before calling a trial unpublished
fix: Report 'no linked paper found', not 'unpublished'

trap: A pooled number hides a real difference
what_you_see: Pooled 72% from 75% (seasonal) and 68% (standard), I2 71%
check: Report heterogeneity with every pooled estimate
fix: Present subgroups

trap: Records older than expected
what_you_see: Papers dated as early as 1914
check: Check value ranges
fix: Widen the range if real; document

trap: Secrets written into files
what_you_see: API key could end up in notebooks or logs
how_found: Check that scans every file for the key
check: Scan outputs for keys before sharing
fix: Keep keys in environment variables only

trap: The agent chooses the scope
what_you_see: A topic filter the brief did not ask for; 25.5% against 20.5% on PubMed papers
how_found: Compared two agent runs and the validated numbers
check: Ask the agent to list every decision that changes the answer
fix: Fix the scope in the brief, or accept the agent's choice in writing

trap: Unscreened records move the recent level
what_you_see: 28% of OpenAlex-only works on topic, against 40% of works in all three sources
check: Rate a sample from each source group
fix: Screen before reporting levels

trap: An African research centre coded to its foreign parent
what_you_see: Authors at MRC Unit The Gambia and KEMRI-Wellcome Kilifi counted as United Kingdom
how_found: OpenAlex and PubMed affiliation countries disagreed one way
check: Compare institution countries with the affiliation text
fix: Prefer the published affiliation text; report both

trap: A trend that rests on the last two years
check: Test windows and drop the current year
fix: Say when the change began; give the result without the partial year

trap: Notices and withdrawn papers counted as research
what_you_see: 30 correction notices, 2 expressions of concern and 4 retracted papers among 12,301 PubMed records; 22 in the Chapter 8 denominators
how_found: Match of DOIs and PMIDs to the Retraction Watch data (via Crossref, 16 Nov 2026) and PubMed publication types
check: Match to Retraction Watch data; filter publication types Retracted Publication, Published Erratum, Expression of Concern
fix: Remove notices; list retracted and flagged papers and decide in the protocol; report the effect on results

trap: A change after an event read as its effect
what_you_see: African-led papers 31% above their pre-2022 trend in 2022-2025 after the October 2021 WHO recommendation; other papers 4% below
how_found: Interrupted time series with a comparison series, 2010-2025
check: Pre-set event date; comparison series; false-date test; list other events in the window
fix: Report as faster growth after the event, not as its effect; name events the design cannot separate (R21 recommendation 2023, rollout 2024)
